pretreatments.description: LHW pretreatment, which involved steam sterilization at 121 °C for 60 minutes with 60% ethanol, dilute acid, or dilute alkali pretreatments conducted with or without surfactants (PEG 6000, Triton X-100, Tween 80) in a 100 mL pressure bottle (solid-to-liquid ratio 1:10) to enhance enzymatic conversion, where variations were grouped under surfactant-assisted LHW pretreatment.

Ethanol pretreatment, where 60% ethanol was used with or without surfactants (PEG 6000, Triton X-100, Tween 80), and investigated in a steam sterilizer at 121 °C for 60 minutes as a representative surfactant-assisted strategy alongside LHW.

H2SO4 pretreatment, where 1% to 3% sulfuric acid was applied with or without surfactants (PEG 6000), as the primary acid pretreatment strategy, with PEG 6000 + 2% H2SO4 noted as the most effective combination for glucose yield.

NaOH pretreatment, where 0.5% sodium hydroxide was used with or without surfactants (PEG 6000, Triton X-100, Tween 80), representing the dilute alkali pretreatment strategy for SCB, compared to other surfactant-assisted strategies.
